name: Procurement Practices
purpose: GRI 204: Procurement Practices 2016 contains disclosures for organizations to report information about their procurement practice-related impacts, and how they manage these impacts. The Standard is structured as follows: • Section 1 contains a requirement, which provides information about how the organization manages its procurement practice-related impacts. • Section 2 contains one disclosure, which provides information about the organization’s procurement practice- related impacts. • The Gloss
